newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Former Yeltsin aide loses case against president.
newsitem.headline: Former Yeltsin aide loses case against president.

text.p: Russia's Supreme Court on Wednesday rejected a suit filed against President Boris Yeltsin by his former bodyguard Alexander Korzhakov.
Korzhakov, who now sits in the State Duma lower house of parliament, had alleged that Yeltsin had made comments "damaging to his honour and dignity" when he was dismissed from office.
Interfax news agency quoted a court official as saying Korzhakov could not appeal against the verdict. He was also ordered to pay eight million roubles ($1,400) in legal expenses.
The burly ex-KGB general, a close ally of the president for 10 years, became a fierce political opponent after his sacking last year, presenting himself as a the victim of a Kremlin plot.
Korzhakov pledged after his sacking to make public "compromising material" against the establishment but never made any major revelations.
